content.title: Arrival
content.body:
I've established a secure spot to catch my breath, which gives me the chance to document my experiences in this unfamiliar land.

I was aware that swamps dominated the landscape here, yet seeing them with my own eyes is something else entirely.

The wildlife and plants don't seem too welcoming, but there's a certain charm to the place despite that.

I'll need to be fully prepared before I explore more. This could be our last chance for a new beginning.
